modes.label: Before bolus or injection

modes.label: Contrast with one-time or abrupt
modes.description: Linking words that set up a one-point or sudden alternative to something gradual or continuous.
modes.example: A gradual reduction in the dose rather<< than>> abrupt cessation is recommended whenever possible.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning instant, sudden or one-time, such as 'instant' and 'snapshot'.
card.plain: It fires on words that lead into a one-time, all-at-once dose such as a single IV bolus.
